title: Never Touch a Taurus's Fries
topic: Taurus zodiac satire: never touch a Taurus's fries
mechanism: Inside a Taurus head there is a bank vault: the door is padlocked with PLANS, a COMFORT dial is stuck on maximum, the floor is bolted down under a NOT MOVING sign and a GRUDGES counter only ever goes up.

beats.hook: Zoe snatches a fry from Ella's plate under a TAURUS sign; Ella's glare freezes her
beats.story: Ella at home: velvet couch, a huge blanket, the same perfume bottle for 12 years
beats.rise: Girls' night is planned perfectly: her table, her pasta, her chair
beats.twist: Priya bursts through the restaurant door: change of plans, new sushi place; Ella's fork freezes and the room goes cold
beats.mechanism: Bank vault inside her head: padlock PLANS on the vault door; dial COMFORT stuck on MAX; floor bolts and sign NOT MOVING; counter GRUDGES at 31 (the fry thief)
beats.ending: Priya eats sushi alone, Ella gets dessert; her cousin reaches for the bread basket and the GRUDGES counter clicks to 32

seed.what: Priya: her empty chair with a PRIYA name card at Ella's planned table, then Priya at the door

locations.set: Room warm, round table, chairs, fries, pasta, TAURUS badge
